statistical_claims: Candidate eRegulon inference across 1828 shared cells tested 1100 motif-linked modules and retained 103 BH-FDR candidate eRegulons (56 pos_tf_pos_p2g and 47 neg_tf_pos_p2g) spanning 103 unique TFs and 3971 TF-enhancer-gene triplets (12 paralog-ambiguous, 0 depth-confounded).

Cis peak-to-gene linkage within 500 kb tested 335963 candidate pairs across 1828 shared cells and identified 21 BH-FDR cis associations (21 positive and 0 negative; 6 promoter-proximal and 15 distal cis).

Cross-modal evidence triangulation across 5 integration stage(s) linked 213 nodes and 290 associative edges into 43 regulatory or latent axes (18 convergent, 12 associative cis candidates, 6 discordant, and 7 caveated ambiguous; WNN guardrail pass).

MOFA+ decomposition across 1828 cells (10 fitted factors) retained 6 active factors (4 shared and 1 modality-specific), quarantined 1 technical or cell-cycle confounder factor(s), and explained non-additive R2 of 45.52% in RNA and 4.39% in ATAC.

Multiome intake (paired_cohort_merge, platform paired_multiome) produced a paired RNA+ATAC container with 6 sample(s), 2400 cells, 36601 RNA genes, 55385 consensus ATAC peaks under barcode translation shared_mudata_obs.
Paired multiome QC retained 1828 of 2400 shared barcodes (23.83% removed) across 36601 RNA genes and 55385 ATAC peaks.
Per-cluster accessibility testing identified 8862 differentially accessible peaks across 11 cluster(s) at padj<0.05, |log2FC|>1.0.
Replicate-level pseudobulk DA ran 1 comparison(s) and found 0 differentially accessible peaks via the shared DESeq2 core.
TF motif enrichment (JASPAR2024_CORE_vertebrates, hypergeometric) tested 879 motifs and found enriched motifs in 9 of 11 peak group(s).
TF-IDF/LSI over 55385 peaks in 2400 cells produced 11 clusters after removing 1 depth-associated component(s).

WNN integration across 1828 shared cells identified 7 joint clusters (vs 8 RNA-only and 6 ATAC-only), mean RNA weight 0.5821 and mean ATAC weight 0.4179, with WNN vs RNA ARI 0.6702 (NMI 0.8854), WNN vs ATAC ARI 0.5765 (NMI 0.7086), 0 discordant cluster(s), and guardrail status pass.
scATAC QC measured 2400 cells and 55385 peaks.
scATAC preprocessing completed (cohort matrix union): the resulting matrix has 2400 cell(s) x 55385 peak(s).
scATAC regulatory-layer analysis ran 1 of 5 optional layer(s); skipped layers are reported with their prerequisites.
